rules_review: The complete official RAD-105/167 face supplies the missing Piltover tag; raw gallery facts and all predecessor reviews are preserved.
Normal exhausted entry and Accelerated ready entry do not exhaust a previously ready unit. Actual Ready-to-Exhausted transitions trigger, including Standard Move costs and effect instructions.
Already exhausted copies do not generate another occurrence. Readying through Irelia permits a second exhaustion trigger in the same turn.
Choose the mode before costs under Core 403.2. The selected draw instruction is a base cost under 204.1.c and 404.1.b.1, paid before responses.
Declining the positive draw cost ends that occurrence under 405.2 and does not switch to Gold. Payment undo retains the chosen mode and restores resources for that attempt.
Gold enters exhausted at Base. Spell-only Power cannot pay the draw ability. The Gold reminder does not give the unit Reaction timing.
The captured chosen effect survives source departure, including an effect that exhausts and then kills the unit before its trigger finalizes.
Separate copies keep their own mode and payment identity. Invalid and stale API actions preserve state; public modes and costs do not expose private draws.
Native controls, all AI levels and Beginner/Advanced Mote advice use the same legal choices.
findings_resolved: Initial catalog tests expected predecessor totals; three Rust harnesses and six Python assertions now expect the appended card and source review.
The old whole-file C28 review-ledger check could not permit a legitimate append. It now verifies the exact archived old bytes and exact unchanged prefixes without rewriting the old proof.
The adjacent Irelia test initially omitted Discipline’s own draw. Its assertion now accounts for both Discipline and Innovator drawing, with no engine behavior change.

Two initial API campaigns assumed every opponent hand stays hidden. The fixture now permits only the exact explicitly revealed cards for RevealHand and Sabotage decisions; no engine visibility behavior changed.
limitations: This addition enables custom-deck practice; it is not a newly verified Irelia tournament preset or proof of current metagame strength.
This acceptance uses native x86-64 Linux builds. The separate Nix acceptance remains the Back Off source at 6411bd141a3bff35eb6491e2a6202496045030bf, recorded in irelia_backoff_nix.json.
